messages:
incident-bot: [P0] KV cache continuous-batching anomaly detected in us-west-2. Large per-tenant cache growth + request amplification. Auto-pager to #eng-oncall. graphs: https://graphs.internal/redwood/kv_cache/alerts/1712456789

Priya: I'm on the page. Quick status: which customers are affected and what's the visible symptom?

Liam: pulling traces. Pattern: after last week's batcher tuning the default max_batch_tokens was increased. We're seeing oversized continuous batches that cause KV prefix eviction storms for some tenants. Resulting in rehydration traffic and 5xx spikes.

Yuna: confirmed via telemetry: tenant-alpha, tenant-omega, and tenant-77 show KV eviction rate x10 and host CPU >80% on affected shards. Token p95 latency jumped from ~0.45s to ~1.9s.

Marco: CS reports tenant-omega experiencing chat stalls and escalated to priority. Preparing customer-facing note.

Priya: mitigation plan: (A) apply per-tenant cap overrides to reduce max_batch_tokens for impacted tenants, (B) pause the global batch_shaper rollout, (C) start a small canary for a conservative config. Any objections?

Liam: no objections. Applying per-tenant overrides now for the three tenants to cut max_batch_tokens to 8192 and reduce window_ms to 10. Also pausing rollout in infra pipeline.

Liam: API command executed:
```
POST /api/flags/batch_shaper/overrides
{ "targets": ["tenant-alpha","tenant-omega","tenant-77"], "settings": {"max_batch_tokens":8192, "window_ms":10} }
```

deploy-bot: Overrides accepted -> id=ovr-20260412-21, rollout=manual

deploy-bot: Global rollout paused by user:infra. action_id=halt-20260412-5

Yuna: metrics (1m after): KV insert rate for targeted tenants dropping, host CPU falling to ~55%, p95 latency improving to ~0.6s, p99 still elevated but trending down. No increase in 5xx beyond baseline.

Priya: good. Next: Liam open rollback PR to revert the default increase and add guardrails (per-tenant cap + amplification telemetry). Marco, send a CS update noting we're mitigating and monitoring. Yuna keep watch on p95/p99 and eviction rates.

Liam: PR opened: infra/rollouts#489 - Revert default max_batch_tokens to 16384, add config option max_batch_tokens_per_tenant_cap=32768, and introduce metric kv_amplification_ratio. Tagging infra and runtime owners.

Marco: CS update queued. Notifying tenant-omega that we applied targeted mitigations; we'll follow up with a timeline once rollback PR merges.

Priya: on-call plan: monitor for 30m. Escalate to P1 if p95 > 1.5s or 5xx > baseline + 0.5%. Yuna keep dashboards up; Liam own PR and runbook updates; Marco handle customer comms. I'll stay on until stable.

Yuna: canary of conservative batch_shaper config (10% traffic, window_ms=10, max_batch_tokens=8192) running -> 10m in, no regression observed, KV insert rates stable, latency steady.

Priya: excellent. Post-incident follow-ups: add alert for sudden per-tenant KV growth (>3x in 5m), automated per-tenant cap enforcement if kv_amplification_ratio exceeds threshold, and update rollout checklist to include per-tenant safety checks.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: per-tenant overrides applied, global rollout paused, conservative canary active. Severity downgraded to P2. last_event=1712457989
